sections.title: Social challenges
sections.content:
Vocabulary for discussing world problems:
• inequality — unfair difference between groups. Income inequality continues to widen globally.
• poverty — the state of being extremely poor. Millions of people still live in extreme poverty.
• humanitarian — concerned with human welfare. Humanitarian aid was sent to the disaster zone.
• displacement — being forced to leave home. The conflict caused mass displacement of civilians.
• epidemic — a widespread occurrence of disease. The obesity epidemic affects developed nations worldwide.

sections.title: Solutions and progress
sections.content:
Discussing positive change:
• empower — give power or authority to. Education empowers people to change their lives.
• advocacy — public support for a cause. Her advocacy for children's rights has inspired millions.
• reform — make changes to improve. The government promised major healthcare reform.
• sustainable development — growth that doesn't harm future generations. Sustainable development balances economy and environment.
• grassroots — ordinary people rather than leaders. The movement started at the grassroots level.

exercises.question: The unfair gap between rich and poor is:
exercises.explanation: Inequality is the unfair difference in social or economic status between groups.

exercises.question: To give people the power to control their own lives is to:
exercises.explanation: Empower means to give someone the authority or power to do something.

exercises.question: A movement started by ordinary people, not leaders, is:
exercises.explanation: Grassroots describes activities organised by ordinary people at a local level.

exercises.question: Being forced to leave your home due to conflict is:
exercises.explanation: Displacement is the forced movement of people from their home area.

exercises.question: Public support for a particular cause is:
exercises.explanation: Advocacy is public support or recommendation of a particular cause.

exercises.question: Making changes to a system to improve it is:
exercises.explanation: Reform means to make changes in order to improve something.

exercises.question: Aid focused on helping people in crisis is:
exercises.hint: Motivated by concern for human welfare.
exercises.explanation: Humanitarian relates to promoting human welfare and reducing suffering.

exercises.question: Growth that meets present needs without harming the future is:
exercises.explanation: Sustainable development meets current needs without compromising future generations.
